Technical Skills (By Category) Programming Languages Essential Strong experience with Java for software test automation. Ability to write clean, reusable, structured, and maintainable code. Ability to troubleshoot and debug automation scripts. Preferred Experience applying object-oriented programming principles to test automation frameworks. Experience developing reusable utilities, libraries, or framework components. Databases/Data Management Essential Experience with database testing. Preferred Experience writing queries to support database validation and test investigation. Exposure to data-driven testing practices. Cloud Technologies Essential Ability to execute and support automated testing in the environments used by the assigned project. Preferred Exposure to cloud-based test environments or test execution platforms. Experience supporting automated tests in distributed application environments. Frameworks and Libraries Essential Selenium for web application automation. TestNG for test organization, execution, and reporting. Maven for project build and dependency management. Experience developing and maintaining automation frameworks using Java. Preferred Experience enhancing existing automation frameworks. Exposure to reusable test libraries, parameterized testing, data-driven testing, or parallel test execution. Development Tools and Methodologies Essential Jenkins for automated test execution or continuous integration support. JIRA for defect tracking and testing-related work management. Knowledge of Agile and Scrum methodologies. Experience with functional and regression testing. Experience with API testing and database testing. Understanding of software testing and quality assurance methodologies. Preferred Experience integrating automated test suites into build or deployment pipelines. Exposure to test reporting, test execution metrics, and automation-maintenance practices. Experience participating in sprint planning, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies. Security Protocols Essential Follow project-defined access, data handling, and testing controls when working with application, API, and database test environments. Preferred Awareness of security considerations in API and database testing. Exposure to validating authentication, authorization, or access-control behavior during testing. Experience Requirements Minimum of 5+ years of professional experience in automation testing or a related software quality assurance role. Prior hands-on experience with Selenium and Java. Experience designing, writing, maintaining, and executing automated test cases. Experience performing functional and regression testing. Experience troubleshooting and debugging automation scripts. Experience with API testing and database testing. Experience using TestNG, Maven, Jenkins, and JIRA in software delivery projects. Experience working with development and QA teams in Agile or Scrum environments. Industry experience in software engineering, enterprise applications, financial services, or other technology-driven environments is preferred where relevant to the assigned project. Candidates may also qualify through equivalent practical experience demonstrating successful delivery of Selenium and Java automation solutions, even where their job title or career path differs from the stated role. Day-to-Day Activities Write, maintain, and execute automated test cases using Selenium, Java, TestNG, and Maven. Troubleshoot and debug automation scripts, analyze test failures, and collaborate with development and QA teams to resolve issues. Review test cases, provide feedback on coverage and quality, and participate in Agile sprint planning and retrospectives. Deliver reliable test results, defect records, and automation updates while making decisions within assigned testing scope and escalating risks or blockers appropriately. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field; equivalent practical experience in software testing or quality assurance may be considered. Minimum of 5+ years of experience in automation testing, including prior experience with Selenium and Java. Practical experience with TestNG, Maven, Jenkins, JIRA, API testing, database testing, and Agile delivery practices. No certification is specified as mandatory; relevant software testing, automation, Agile, or tool-specific certifications are preferred where applicable. Complete role-relevant training and maintain continuous professional development in automation frameworks, testing practices, API validation, database testing, and Agile methodologies. Professional Competencies Apply critical thinking, structured analysis, and root-cause investigation to identify and resolve automation and software quality issues. Collaborate effectively with development and QA teams to coordinate testing activities, resolve defects, and support delivery objectives. Communicate test results, risks, defects, dependencies, and recommendations clearly to technical and project stakeholders. Adapt to changing requirements, application technologies, testing environments, and Agile delivery priorities. Identify opportunities to improve test coverage, reuse automation assets, reduce repetitive effort, and strengthen testing efficiency. Manage testing activities, defect priorities, sprint commitments, and competing tasks with attention to detail and timely escalation. title: QA Engineering
description: The Opportunity: Build the future of Wealth In a fintech world obsessed with gamification and speculative betting, Endowus stands apart. We aren't here to build another trading app; we are building the financial infrastructure to help people achieve long-term life goals - retirement, education, and financial freedom. Headquartered in Singapore, we are the largest independent digital wealth platform in Asia . However, we are not a one-trick robo-advisor. We are a full-suite wealth platform spanning public equities, fixed income, private markets, and hedge funds. We provide clients with customized exposure—global, regional, or sectoral—across all their wealth (from liquid cash to pension savings) and for all their needs (from short-term cash management to long-term retirement planning). Just six years after launch, we manage over US$10 Billion (:₹90,000 Crore) in assets for more than a quarter-million clients across Singapore and Hong Kong. We are a Series B company backed by global giants (Lightspeed, Illuminate, Prosus, EDBI, UBS), with ambitions to cover the entire region. This is not an 'offshore' support role. Our India team is a core product hub , operating on parity with our Singapore HQ. Engineers here drive end-to-end ownership of platform innovation. You won't just be testing code; you will be engineering the safety nets that allow us to move fast without breaking trust. The Role: Engineering Confidence Most companies treat QA as a final checkpoint. We treat it as an engineering discipline. Our clients trust us with their life savings. "Move fast and break things" is not an option here. What we need is "Move fast and prove it's safe." Here's what you can look forward to in this role. Engineer the Safety Net: You will build and maintain scalable automation scripts that cover the entire stack - from Backend APIs (Scala/Akka) to Web (React) and Mobile (Flutter). You ensure our regression tests are reliable and fast. Shift Quality Left: You will collaborate with Product Managers and Developers before a line of code is written. You will review requirements for testability and ensure edge cases are caught during the design phase. Pragmatic Quality: While automation is our north star, we value thoughtful test planning and the human eye. You are willing to roll up your sleeves and perform manual exploratory testing because you know when to automate and when to test/investigate manually. Drive CI/CD Velocity: You will integrate your tests into our CI/CD pipelines. You ensure that our feedback loops are fast so developers can fix issues immediately. Guardian of the Client Experience: You will look beyond functional correctness. You will simulate real-world client behaviors to catch usability friction, performance lags, and data inconsistencies that automated checks might miss. Our Tech Stack Web Automation: We use Playwright for high-speed, reliable end-to-end testing of our React applications. Backend Automation: We use Cucumber-Scala to test our distributed microservices (Scala/Akka) and ensure our domain logic holds up under pressure. Mobile Automation: We leverage Maestro E2E and flutter tests for our Dart/Flutter mobile apps. Ops: We are 100% cloud-native (AWS) and rely heavily on CI/CD to run your tests on every commit. Want to look under the hood? Read how we solve testing challenges on our Engineering Blog at tech.endowus.com What Success Looks Like First 30 Days (Immersion): You understand our domain models and testing infrastructure. You have added a new regression test and performed manual testing for a new feature release. First 90 Days (Ownership): You are actively writing automated tests for new features within the sprint. You have built a deep understanding of many domain flows and have plugged several gaps in our current test coverage. First 6 Months (Impact): You now own the test planning & execution for major new initiatives and are actively elevating the quality of our platform with a founder mentality. What You Bring (Requirements) We care more about your engineering intuition than your ability to memorize APIs. However, this role requires a specific baseline: Must-Haves : 4+ Years of Test Engineering: You have solid experience in automation. You are comfortable writing code to test code, but you also respect the value of manual validation. Strong Coding Fundamentals: You are proficient in at least one major language (Java, Scala, TypeScript, or Python). You can read developer code to understand where a bug might be hiding. Automation Framework Competence: You have experience using and extending frameworks like Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium. You can write stable, maintainable scripts. API Testing DNA: You are comfortable testing microservices. You understand REST, JSON, and how to query a database (SQL) to verify test states. Collaborative Mindset: You don't wait for a "hand-off." You actively ask developers and PMs questions about implementation details to plan your tests better Nice-to-Haves : Mobile Automation: Experience testing Flutter or native apps using Appium or Maestro. Performance Testing: Experience with K6, Gatling, or JMeter. FinTech Domain: You understand financial concepts, ledgers, or high-security environments Why Endowus? Modern Stack, Serious Business: You get to apply modern automation tools to mission-critical financial infrastructure. You get the intellectual depth of a top-tier private bank with the agility of a startup. World-Class Engineering Talent: You will work with colleagues from top product companies like Amazon, Google, Swiggy, Flipkart, Grab, and Meta. We bring together strong fintech DNA with the best of agile startup culture. Career Growth with Upside: We manage massive AUA ($10 billion and growing) with a lean, high-talent team (:85 in product engineering). This means high visibility, high impact, and significant ESOP upside in a company that is defining the category. Leadership Pedigree: Our leadership team brings experience from Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, UBS, McKinsey, Bloomberg, Amazon, Alibaba, Grab, Shopee, Salesforce, and more. Why NOT Endowus? We want you to thrive here, which means we must be honest about the environment. You prefer 100% Automation: If you thrive best when writing code all day and prefer to minimize manual exploration with the product or learning the domain inside-out, our hybrid approach might not suit you. You prefer a Centralized QA Structure: If you prefer working in a dedicated QA team with clear hand-offs from developers, you might find our cross-functional team structure (Backend + Frontend + QA + PM + Design) challenging. You prefer executing over planning: If you do your best work when given a pre-written test plan to execute step-by-step, this role might be too broad. We need engineers who can look at a feature spec and derive the test strategy themselves. You want 100% Remote: We work in the office at least 3 days a week because we believe in the serendipity of in-person collaboration The Interview Process We respect your time and aim to be thorough yet efficient. Recruiter Screen (30 min): Quick alignment on role, stack, and mission. Online Coding Assessment (90 min): A hands-on coding challenge to assess your coding and scripting fundamentals along with Test planning Technical Deep Dive (90 min): Live coding and discussion. We focus on automation logic, framework usage, and how you approach manual vs. automated scenarios. System Design (60 min): We talk about test strategies for distributed systems, API testing, and data management. Culture & Values (60 min): Meeting with Leadership to ensure we are a match. Our Investors, recognition, licensing Founded in 2017, Endowus has raised over US$130 million from investors including UBS, EDBI, Prosus Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Citi Ventures, MUFG Innovation Partners, Singtel Innov8, Samsung Ventures, SBVA, Illuminate Financial, OSK Ventures, Z Venture Capital, and ACF – a joint venture between JLIN LLC and The Wells Investments. Endowus also counts some of the largest billionaire family offices in Asia among its investors. Endowus partners with 1,000+ global fund managers across public markets, private markets, hedge funds, and alternatives to deliver world-class solutions at transparent cost through its fee-only model. Private Wealth clients access curated strategies from firms such as EQT, Carlyle, Partners Group, KKR, Ares, Brookfield Oaktree, HarbourVest, Millennium, Point72, Bridgewater, and more.Recognition includes CNBC's World's Top FinTech Companies 2025, the Financial Times' High-Growth Companies Asia Pacific 2025 (#45), Fortune Fintech Innovators Asia 2024, and the World Economic Forum's Technology Pioneers 2023. The platform has won Asia's Best Digital Wealth Management and Hong Kong's Best FinTech Innovation in Asset Management (Asia Asset Management 2025), Singapore's Best Digital Wealth Management Experience (The Asset Triple A 2025), and Best WealthTech Solution 2023 (Asian Private Banker). The Endowus Group comprises licensed companies in Hong Kong and Singapore, and Hong Kong-based multi-family office Carret Private. With group assets over US$12 billion , Endowus is one of the largest independent wealth managers in Asia, estimated to save clients more than US$50 million in fees per year.

title: Test Automation (Java+Selenium+Rest Assured) – Test Lead
description: Job Description: Test Automation (Java+Selenium+Rest Assured) – Test Lead We are looking for a hands-on QA Automation Engineer who brings solid experience across both manual and automation testing, with particular strength in API testing. You will design, build, and maintain scalable UI and API automation using Selenium WebDriver with Java and Rest Assured, and work closely with developers, product owners, and fellow testers to deliver high-quality releases. We value engineers who think through problems logically, explain their reasoning clearly, and adapt their solutions as requirements evolve. Experience should have 5 to 8 years of experience in software quality assurance and test automation. Selenium with Strong Java, REST API testing, CI/CD and SQL. Analyze requirements and user stories to design comprehensive test scenarios, test cases, and test data covering functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end flows. Perform manual testing where appropriate, including exploratory, smoke, sanity, and regression testing, and log clear, reproducible defects. Design, develop, and maintain UI automation frameworks using Selenium WebDriver with Java, following Page Object Model and clean coding practices. Build and maintain API automation suites using Rest Assured, covering REST endpoints end to end. Validate API responses thoroughly: status codes, headers, response body, JSON/XML schema, data types, business rules, error handling, and negative scenarios. Perform database testing by writing SQL queries to verify that data created, updated, or deleted through the UI and APIs is stored correctly in the backend. Validate data integrity, constraints, relationships, and business rules across tables, including checks for duplicates, nulls, and mismatches between API responses and database records. Integrate database validations into the automation framework using JDBC, so UI and API tests can assert directly against the database. Prepare, seed, and clean up test data in the database to keep test runs independent and repeatable. Build parameterized, data-driven tests that handle dynamic inputs through configuration files, external test data, and environment-specific settings rather than hard-coded values. Refactor and extend existing automation to accommodate changing requirements while keeping it maintainable and reusable. Integrate automation suites into CI/CD pipelines and support scheduled and on-demand executions. Analyze test results, triage failures, and distinguish genuine defects from environment or script issues. Contribute to test strategy, estimation, and continuous improvement of QA processes within an Agile Team. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong interpersonal skills, team player and extremely resourceful. Proven ability to complete projects according to outlined scope and timeline. Very good written and oral communication skills.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate clearly across technical and non-technical audiences. Proficiency in English. title: Principle SDET
description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. About The Technology Organization Technology at Lilly builds and operates mission-critical digital products and platforms that support the discovery, development, and delivery of medicines that make life better for people around the world. Our teams operate in highly regulated, high-availability environments, where operational excellence, reliability, and quality are non-negotiable. Within Tech@Lilly, the Digital Core organization applies a product, platform, and reliability-first mindset, ensuring that operational capabilities scale sustainably across the enterprise. About The Team Tech@Lilly builds and maintains capabilities using pioneering technologies like the most prominent tech companies. What differentiates Lilly IT is that we redefine what's possible through tech to advance our purpose, creating medicines that make life better for people around the world, including data-driven drug discovery, connected clinical trials, resilient enterprise platforms, and intelligent digital operations. We hire the best technology professionals from a variety of backgrounds, so they can bring an assortment of knowledge, skills, and diverse thinking to deliver creative solutions in every area of our business. The Digital Core team leads Lilly's transformation into the Digital and AI era. They inspire digitally empowered teams to new ways of working and accelerate innovation and agility. This team powers and advances the entire company by building and maintaining world-class technology capabilities and platforms. Lilly Capability Centre India (LCCI), Hyderabad, is Lilly's premier Global Technology Hub, harnessing data, AI, analytics, and digital solutions to revolutionize healthcare and improve patient outcomes worldwide. The Reliability Engineering team is the engineering-first function that owns operations, incident response, runbook automation, and the safe evaluation of agentic remediation across a multi-application production estate. This role sits inside that team and owns test engineering for the work it ships, partnering closely with the peer engineering team that builds the agentic automation platform. Role Summary As a Principal Software Development Engineer in Test, you own the quality bar for the Reliability Engineering function and act as the shift-left engineering partner across the wider application support organization. You are an engineer first and a tester second. You write code, you build test frameworks, you instrument quality signals into pipelines, and you raise the engineering standard for everything that ships through the team. This is not a manual QA role and it is not a role that catches defects late. You move quality left into design reviews, code reviews, CI gates, and observability, and you build the automated test machinery that lets a small engineering team ship agentic runbooks, remediation logic, and operational platforms with confidence. You are the engineer the team relies on to make sure what reaches production has been engineered for verifiability from the start. You partner with the senior reliability engineering leads, the agentic platform engineering team, and the senior architect. You are the single named owner for test strategy across your function, and the consulting voice on quality engineering across the wider organization. What You'll Be Doing Shift-left test engineering and design partnership Embed in design reviews and architecture conversations before code is written. Raise testability, observability, and failure-mode questions early, and make sure the answers are engineered in, not bolted on. Define the test strategy for each platform, runbook, or agent the team ships, including unit, contract, integration, end-to-end, and behavioural tests for agentic and AI-augmented components. Set the quality gates that releases must clear in CI, and own the conversation when a gate blocks a release. The gates exist because you defended them. Test automation framework engineering Build and maintain the test automation frameworks used across the reliability and agentic engineering teams. Engineers consume what you build; you do not write tests case by case for them. Engineer test harnesses for agentic systems: deterministic evaluation of agent outputs, regression suites for prompt and policy changes, golden-set comparison, and replay-based testing for runbook automation. Build contract tests between the agentic automation layer, the observability platform, the ITSM system of record, and the applications they act on, so changes on either side surface in CI rather than in production. Build chaos and resilience tests that exercise failure paths the team would not otherwise see until an incident. CI/CD quality gating and pipeline ownership Own the quality stages in the team's CI/CD pipelines, including static analysis, security scanning hooks, coverage thresholds, performance regression checks, and gating policies. Drive shift-left static analysis, security linting, and dependency-risk checks into pull-request workflows, and tune them so they catch real issues without becoming noise. Engineer pre-production environments that mirror production sufficiently to validate runbook automation and agentic actions safely, including data masking, synthetic traffic, and replay harnesses. Quality observability and signal engineering Treat observability as a testing surface. Engineer test signals into OpenTelemetry instrumentation so the same telemetry that runs production also validates correctness in lower environments. Build dashboards and queries (Splunk or equivalent) that surface quality signals — escaped defects, flaky tests, coverage drift, agent decision accuracy — to engineering leads and senior technology leadership. Validate SLO instrumentation in partnership with the reliability engineering leads, including burn-rate alerting tests and synthetic probes. Regulated-environment readiness and audit-grade evidence Engineer test evidence that holds up under GxP, SOX, and HIPAA scrutiny: traceability from requirement to test to result, repeatable runs, signed artefacts, and change-controlled test assets. Partner with the validation and quality functions on computer system validation expectations for operational platforms and agentic remediation, and translate those expectations into automated checks where possible. Make sure the test estate itself is treated as code: versioned, reviewed, and deployed through the same pipelines as production software. Quality leadership across the organization Act as the consulting quality engineer for the agentic platform engineering team and the broader reliability function when those teams need shift-left advice or framework support. Coach engineers in writing the tests that should ship with their code, and raise the engineering bar on test design through code reviews. Mentor junior engineers and operational anchors on test automation skills as part of the team's capability uplift. How You Will Succeed At the principal level, success is defined by leverage and by the quality of what reaches production: You ship test frameworks and CI machinery that other engineers reuse, not isolated test suites tied to one project. Defects that should have been caught in CI are caught in CI; the ones that escape are rare, well-understood, and inform the next gate you build. Agentic and automated remediation in production behaves the way the team said it would, because you engineered the evaluation that proved it. The team writes more tests, not because they are told to, but because the frameworks you built make doing the right thing the easy thing. Required What you should bring 10+ years of professional engineering experience, with at least 5 years specifically in test engineering, SDET, or quality engineering roles where you owned automation frameworks and CI quality gates, not just test execution. Hands-on engineering background in Python and at least one of Java, TypeScript, or Go, with the kind of fluency where you ship the test framework yourself rather than specify it for someone else. Deep, hands-on experience with at least two major test automation stacks (for example: pytest plus a suitable end-to-end framework, Playwright or Selenium for UI, Postman/Newman or REST Assured or schemathesis for APIs, Locust or k6 for performance). Strong CI/CD engineering background, including authoring pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or equivalent), designing quality gates, and tuning them so they remain useful rather than ignored. Working fluency with a modern observability and ITSM toolchain — Splunk or equivalent for observability and quality signal surfacing, ServiceNow or equivalent as the system of record, Terraform for infrastructure-as-code, at least one major public cloud (AWS preferred), and OpenTelemetry for instrumentation. Demonstrated shift-left practice: participation in design reviews, contract-first development, test-driven or behaviour-driven development at meaningful scale, and a point of view on where shift-left pays off versus where it adds friction. Experience operating in a regulated or audited environment (GxP, SOX, HIPAA, PCI, or equivalent), with comfort around change control, audit evidence, and validated-system constraints. Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related engineering field. Preferred Hands-on experience testing AI-augmented or agentic systems, including evaluation harnesses, golden-set regression, prompt and policy drift detection, and human-in-the-loop validation patterns. Experience contributing to chaos and resilience testing programs (AWS Fault Injection Service, Gremlin, LitmusChaos, or equivalent) tied to measurable reliability outcomes. Familiarity with computer system validation (CSV) and GxP test documentation expectations in pharma or life sciences technology environments. Background in performance and load engineering, including baseline-and-regress practice and the ability to defend performance targets with data. Mentoring engineers on test craft and influencing peers without org-chart authority through code, design reviews, and engineering documents. Formal certifications welcome but not required, such as ISTQB Advanced, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or equivalent. Leadership expectations Leads through code, frameworks, and design reviews — not through ceremony. Treats test code with the same engineering rigour as production code. Holds the quality bar consistently and without it becoming political, even when a deadline is in tension with a gate. Brings shift-left thinking into rooms where it is not yet the default, and earns the right to be heard there by doing the engineering work. Operates as the named quality-engineering owner for the reliability function, and as the consulting voice on quality across the wider organization. Additional Information Availability to work flexible work hours is/may be required. This team supports continuous operations and may require non-standard work hours, including some work on weekends and holidays. Appropriate adjustments in benefits will be provided for employees working non-standard hours where applicable. This is an onsite role based in Hyderabad. Candidates should be open to working with global delivery partners across time zones, with occasional shift flexibility when production-critical validation work requires it. Together with State Street’s Middle and Back-office services, Charles River’s cloud-based Front Office technology forms the foundation of the State Street Alpha® Platform, the first front-to-back solution in the industry. Our vision is to be the world’s leading investment platform, shaping the future of the industry and driving new levels of technology-led innovation, resiliency, efficiency and growth for investors and the people they serve. CRD Engineering organization is innovating and transforming the platform by moving away from monolithic software to utilising next generation cloud-based technology that leverages Microsoft Azure, Kafka, Snowflake, etc. Industry momentum has seen CRD grow over 135% in headcount over the last 5 years, and we continue to grow. As a digital innovation leader, we invest into our solutions, processes, systems, and talent. As a part of our talent growth strategy, CRD Engineering is actively hiring in Dublin as we are investing in growing our European presence. Our senior leadership team will be hosting in-person interview panels during our recruiting drive in the late September 2024. Summary Work as a senior member of automation center of excellence team to execute the overall quality plan for Charles River’s products. Provide support and assistance to customers and other teams within Charles River. The candidate should be a sharp automation framework engineer with strong problem-solving skills and a solid automation test framework building foundation. This role requires a talented, detail oriented, enthusiastic individual who is passionate about quality with the ability to grasp tough issues quickly and deliver well engineered, high-quality solutions. We are looking for a strong software engineer to build out the next generation of our software test automation framework and infrastructure as part of our Quality Assurance Infrastructure team. The candidate will be responsible for developing, delivering and supporting the software infrastructure that enables automated product validation. This position provides services for planning and the execution of central automated regression runs for all product departments. In addition, this candidate is responsible for maintaining and expanding the labs which host both automated and manual testing as well as conducting staging and certification of the product media during the ship-stage of a release. Financial services industry experience is preferred. Responsibilities Work closely with the scrum master, product owner, architect, business analysts, product specialists, developers and other project team members to assist in carrying out the software quality responsibilities of the Scrum team Expand the test automation framework capabilities needed to comprehensively test business requirements for all products and services Create pipelines to execute automated functional, integration, regression, and performance tests Maintain automated and manual test script libraries for functional, integration, regression, and performance testing Align with the Software Development Life Cycle practices, comply with Information Security and Data Governance practices Interpret results of automation tests and document software defects in issue tracking system; proactively communicate issues with developers and other project team members Provide testing leadership by identifying opportunities for improvement in the Scrum team’s QA methodology, innovate by researching and recommending new approaches to automation of testing, including use of Artificial Intelligence Adhere to a testing schedule to ensure efficient and effective product delivery Actively participate in the agile software development process by adhering to the CRD Scrum methodology including attending all daily standups, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives Participate in “testathon” activities as required by releases Guide and mentor junior staff in best practices and proper creation of automated test scripts. Qualifications Education: B.S. degree (or foreign education equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, and Physics or other technical course of study or Business with an MIS background. MS degree strongly preferred. Experience: 10-12 years of experience in building test automation frameworks in enterprise world and in a process driven technology environment Demonstrated experience programming with JAVA, SQL and shell scripting languages such as PowerShell and Bash Demonstrated experience implementing automation framework with industry standard tools like Rest Assured, Playwright, Azure SDK, Kafka SDK, Cosmos DB, Swagger, Silk4Net, FlaUI, Talend strongly preferred Demonstrated experience implementing and executing automation test scripts against web, native/desktop applications, APIs and batch applications. Experience with creating and updating on-demand pipelines and experience with relevant tools TeamCity, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, Argo CD is preferred Demonstrated experience using test cases, scripts, and automated test tools for verifying requirements on multi-tier applications Demonstrated ability translating business requirements into comprehensive functional and technical test plans Knowledgeable in one or more CRD functional areas is a plus A minimum of 3 years working with an Agile development methodology strongly desired Effective written and verbal communication. title: QA Lead
description: Role Overview We are seeking an experienced and technically strong QA Lead (Manual & Automation) with 4+ years of hands-on experience to join our engineering team. You will play a critical role in driving our quality assurance strategy, architecting scalable test automation frameworks, and executing high-impact manual exploratory testing. In this role, you will collaborate closely with product management, development, DevOps, and security teams in a fast-paced Agile environment to establish robust testing standards, optimize regression feedback loops, and ensure high-quality, resilient software delivery. What You’ll Do QA Leadership & Quality Strategy: Lead end-to-end testing efforts across web, mobile, and API layers throughout the SDLC. Define test strategies, author comprehensive test plans, establish quality metrics/KPIs, and make data-driven release readiness decisions. Test Automation Engineering: Design, build, and maintain enterprise-grade test automation frameworks for UI and API layers. Integrate automated suites into modern CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing and rapid feedback loops. Manual & Exploratory Testing: Perform deep exploratory, functional, regression, edge-case, and smoke testing for complex microservices and feature rollouts. Ensure end-to-end user workflows function seamlessly across environments. API & Integration Testing: Conduct thorough RESTful API testing, contract validation, and integration testing using tools like Postman, REST Assured, or Playwright API modules. Defect Management & Root Cause Analysis: Identify, document, track, and triage bugs using Jira. Participate in release management, validate pre-production builds, perform post-deployment verification, and execute root cause analysis (RCA) on production incidents. Security & Compliance Testing: Collaborate with DevSecOps to incorporate basic security testing standards, data privacy validation, and vulnerability checks into test plans, upholding enterprise data protection protocols. Collaboration & Mentorship: Mentor junior QA engineers, conduct peer code and test case reviews, advocate for Shift-Left quality practices, and participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, and architecture reviews. Qualifications & Requirements Experience: 4+ years of dedicated hands-on experience in Software Quality Assurance, with a proven track record in a senior or lead capacity. Automation Expertise: Strong hands-on experience building and scaling automation frameworks using tools such as Cypress, Playwright, Selenium, or Appium (in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, or Java). Manual Testing & Strategy: Exceptional analytical skills for requirement analysis, test design, user journey mapping, and exploratory testing methodologies. API Testing: Proficient in API test design, payload validation, and toolsets like Postman, REST Assured, or Swagger. CI/CD & DevOps Integration: Solid experience integrating automated tests into continuous integration pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI). Database & SQL: Working knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and running complex SQL queries for data verification and test setup. Agile & Process: Deep understanding of Agile/Scrum delivery models, sprint ceremonies, and quality governance. Preferred Skills (Nice-to-Have) Certifications: ISTQB Advanced Level (Test Analyst / Test Manager) or AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner. Performance Testing: Hands-on exposure to load and performance testing tools (JMeter, k6, or Locust). Security & Scanning: Familiarity with static security analysis tools (SonarQube) and basic web security concepts (OWASP Top 10). Data & Event Systems: Familiarity with testing event-driven architectures, caching, and message queues (Kafka, Redis, or RabbitMQ). Information Security & ISO 27001 Compliance Security is at the heart of everything we do. In this role, you will be strictly required to uphold our Information Security Management System (ISMS) policies in alignment with ISO/IEC 27001 standards. Responsibilities include safeguarding sensitive asset data, completing mandatory security awareness training, reporting potential security incidents or vulnerabilities immediately, and ensuring daily QA operations comply with rigorous data protection protocols.

Automation Expertise: Strong hands-on experience building and scaling automation frameworks using tools such as Cypress, Playwright, Selenium, or Appium (in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, or Java). Manual Testing & Strategy: Exceptional analytical skills for requirement analysis, test design, user journey mapping, and exploratory testing methodologies. API Testing: Proficient in API test design, payload validation, and toolsets like Postman, REST Assured, or Swagger. CI/CD & DevOps Integration: Solid experience integrating automated tests into continuous integration pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI). Data & Event Systems: Familiarity with testing event-driven architectures, caching, and message queues (Kafka, Redis, or RabbitMQ). title: Salesforce QA
description: THE OPPORTUNITY This is a full-time Engineering Square role placed with the client. You manually test every change before it is released and run regression before every release — across Experience Cloud partner portals, a consumer-lending platform and the Salesforce ↔ NetSuite integration — working inside the client's Jira boards and CI/CD pipeline with the pod's Tech Lead and developer as your daily partners. You own the test evidence on every story. RESPONSIBILITIES Test every change before release: manual functional testing of Apex, Lightning Web Component and Flow changes on both Salesforce orgs against the acceptance criteria in the Jira ticket; exploratory testing around the change Run regression before every release: own the regression checklist across portals, lending flows and integrations; execute it in full before each release; keep it current as features ship; record the result as release evidence Test Experience Cloud portals: partner and customer sites — self-registration and onboarding, login including federated single sign-on, sharing and guest-user visibility, page and LWC behaviour across partner roles, personas and devices Test lending flows: application intake, status visibility, document and e-signature steps, and post-origination hand-offs (funding, disbursement, servicing) built on custom objects alongside the managed loan-origination package Test integrations end to end: the Salesforce ↔ NetSuite quote-to-cash sync (customer/account, product and pricing, opportunity → sales order, invoice and payment status back-sync), partner APIs and Platform Events — field mappings, error handling and retries, duplicate and idempotency checks, and record-level reconciliation across Salesforce, NetSuite and Snowflake Attach documented test evidence to every story before release — test cases, results, screenshots and defect logs; log, triage and retest defects in Jira; keep test plans and the regression checklist current in Confluence Join the client's daily standup inside the overlap window; report test status, risks and blockers directly to client stakeholders; provide the testing line for the Tech Lead's Friday written summary CONTEXT YOU WILL WORK IN Two Salesforce orgs. The manufacturer runs a Sales, Service and Experience Cloud org with an installer partner portal (self-registration, knowledge, support). Its consumer-financing affiliate runs a separate org on a Salesforce-native loan and lease origination managed package, with its own installer partner portal (login federated to an external identity provider). Around both sit NetSuite (ERP — the Salesforce ↔ NetSuite quote-to-cash integration is the lead backlog item), Snowflake (financing and credit-risk analytics), an AWS integration layer (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS) and an integration platform. Testing spans both orgs, the portals and the data hand-offs between them. MUST-HAVE SKILLS Salesforce testing: hands-on manual functional and regression testing of Sales Cloud / Service Cloud — objects, fields, validation rules, Flows, profiles, permission sets and record-level security; writes clear, reproducible test cases and defect reports Experience Cloud testing: has tested at least one partner or customer portal — user registration and onboarding, login and access across partner roles, sharing and guest-user visibility, multi-persona and cross-device checks. Candidates who have tested a partner portal go to the top of the list Financial-process testing: has tested a lending, financial-services or order-to-cash process on Salesforce — understands status lifecycles, document steps, calculations and the sensitivity of the data; works on masked or synthetic data only Integration testing: verifies data flows across REST/SOAP APIs with Postman or equivalent; compares records across systems; working SOQL for data checks; reads integration and API logs to isolate a defect to the right system Regression discipline: builds and maintains a regression checklist, executes it completely before every release, and produces evidence a client can audit Delivery tooling: Jira for test management and defects, Confluence for documentation, Git basics; familiarity with SFDX and GitHub Actions pipelines; works to a release checklist Communication: camera-on meetings, direct stakeholder communication in clear English; reports status without being asked; raises risks early, never late; works the US business calendar and US federal holidays Overlap: a daily overlap of at least 4 hours with US Pacific time (mandatory); confirmed in the first screen Experience: 1–3 years in software QA, including at least 1 year testing Salesforce and at least one portal or financial-process implementation NICE TO HAVE Test automation for the regression suite — Provar, Selenium or Playwright — run in the client's CI/CD pipeline Exposure to Q2 Cloud Lending / Symphonix or another Salesforce-native loan-origination package; NetSuite or another ERP (order-to-cash flows); middleware such as Workato, MuleSoft or Boomi SQL against Snowflake or another warehouse for reconciliation checks; Data Loader and Workbench for test-data setup API automation (Postman collections, Rest Assured) and bulk-data or performance testing AI-assisted test-case generation and AI-enabled testing workflows, on masked or synthetic data only Solar-financing, renewable-energy or fintech domain; prior experience working with US enterprise clients from offshore

What you’ll build and own Design and execute comprehensive test strategies, test plans, and test cases. Perform manual testing to identify functional, integration, usability, and edge-case issues. Validate AI-generated code and features to ensure they meet quality, maintainability, and business requirements. Investigate defects, perform root cause analysis, and collaborate with developers on solutions. Contribute to quality best practices and continuous improvement initiatives across projects. Participate in requirement reviews and help identify risks early in the development process. Core Requirements 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance or Software Testing. Strong experience with both manual and automated testing methodologies. Experience testing web applications, APIs, mobile apps, and backend systems. Hands-on experience with automation tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, WebdriverIO , or similar. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and modern software development workflows. Ability to review application code and understand system behavior when investigating issues. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Ability to work independently in a remote, fast-paced environment. Nice-to-Have Experience testing software developed with AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, or ChatGPT. Programming experience in JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, C#, or similar languages. Experience with performance, security, accessibility, or load testing. Experience contributing to test strategy, QA processes, or quality initiatives at a senior level. Comfortable working flexible hours to overlap with distributed teams across different time zones. Additional US Timezone Overlap : 5h–6h daily PST Why Join Kake? The icing on the Kake: 💰 Competitive Pay in USD: Work globally, get paid globally. 🌎 Fully Remote: Simply put, we trust you. 💜 Better Me Fund: We invest in your personal growth and passions. 🎂 Compassion is Badass: Join a community that invests in social good. Ready for your piece of the Kake? Apply now! Quick note: Due to the high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Senior QA Engineer 1
description: Founded in 2004, NetBrain is the leader in no-code network automation. Its ground-breaking Next-Gen platform provides IT operations teams with the ability to scale their hybrid multi-cloud connected networks by automating the processes associated with Diagnostic Troubleshooting, Outage Prevention and Protected Change Management. Today, over 2,500 of the world’s largest enterprises and managed services providers leverage NetBrain’s platform. What We Need NetBrain is looking for an experienced Senior QA Engineer to work on a variety of automation-related projects for our unparalleled network automation platform, powered by agentic-AI. We need a detail-oriented and logical programmer who loves to be part of a team and is comfortable collaborating across multiple areas of the organization. NetBrain has a global presence with offices worldwide. There are opportunities for employees with top performance to transfer to other offices in the future. What You'll Do Provide guidance and support to junior QA engineers and share best practices. Develop detailed test plans and test strategies from requirements and specifications. Design comprehensive test cases and scenarios covering functional and non-functional requirements. Execute manual and automated tests across functional, regression, performance, usability, and security areas. Identify, document, track, and help resolve software defects with development teams. Collect and analyze quality metrics and prepare test reports for stakeholders. Participate in design and code reviews from a QA perspective. Evaluate and recommend QA tools and technologies. Maintain QA environments, tools, and test data. Assess release risks and recommend mitigation strategies. Ensure software meets internal standards, regulatory expectations, and best practices. Develop and maintain automated scripts and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines. Act as a liaison between customers and the development team on quality concerns. Perform any other responsibilities assigned. What You Are Bachelor’s degree with typically 5+ years of related experience, or Master’s degree with 3+ years, or equivalent work experience. Cloud experience, preferably AWS. Large-scale software testing experience, including databases such as MongoDB, Oracle, MySQL, and PostgreSQL. Experience with API testing tools such as Postman. Performance testing experience. Proficiency in scripting/programming languages such as Python, C++, or Java. Experience with automation tools such as Jenkins and Selenium. Knowledge of network monitoring tools. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Experience working with cross-functional teams. Nice to have Skills Networking or cloud certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, JNCIA, or JNCIP. Hands-on ITSM data analysis for automation opportunities. Experience with customer-facing content such as knowledge base articles or training videos. Ability to deliver in-person or virtual product training. Mentoring or coaching experience with junior QA team members. NetBrain invites all interested and qualified candidates to apply for employment opportunities. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by law. description: Our client is modernizing its in-store application platform supporting approximately 7,000 restaurants within a broader 30,000+ store ecosystem, transforming a legacy monolithic .NET application into an offline-first, event-driven platform using AWS microservices, Lambda, and cloud-native services. The new architecture synchronizes lightweight in-store devices—including POS registers, kitchen displays, and kiosks—across Windows, Linux, and Android. The foundational platform team owns the shared AWS backend architecture and on-device framework, enabling other teams to build front-end register workflows and in-store hardware integrations on a scalable, resilient platform. Define test coverage across the on-device app and the AWS services this work stream touches. Build and own automation frameworks that go beyond basic UI record-and-replay automation. Mentor the pod's Mid QE and coordinate test cycles with the Pod Lead and engineers. Report quality risk and coverage gaps to the Delivery Manager and Pod Lead. Hands-on with UI automation (Selenium WebDriver) and API testing (Postman or comparable) to build/own automation frameworks that go well beyond simple "record and replay" scripts. Comfortable defining test coverage across both an on-device application layer and backend AWS services. Nice to have experience with sync/CRDT-style systems; POS or retail-hardware testing experience. We offer Opportunity to work on bleeding-edge projects Work with a highly motivated and dedicated team Competitive salary Flexible schedule Benefits package - medical insurance, sports Corporate social events Professional development opportunities Well-equipped office About Us Grid Dynamics (NASDAQ: GDYN) is a leading provider of technology consulting, platform and product engineering, AI, and advanced analytics services. Fusing technical vision with business acumen, we solve the most pressing technical challenges and enable positive business outcomes for enterprise companies undergoing business transformation. A key differentiator for Grid Dynamics is our 8 years of experience and leadership in enterprise AI, supported by profound expertise and ongoing investment in data, analytics, cloud & DevOps, application modernization and customer experience. title: Presales Solution Architect, Quality Engineering (AI and GenAI)
description: Digital Engineering (DE-QE) | Hyderabad, India | Work from office OSI Digital is seeking an experienced Presales Solution Consultant for its Quality Engineering practice. This person owns presales for QE and drives QE accelerators as a product line: turning customer testing problems into scoped, defensible solutions and commercial proposals, and building reusable QE assets that OSI can sell repeatedly. The role is customer facing and solution led, not a pure delivery seat. It suits someone with real QE delivery depth, strong research instincts, and genuine hands-on AI and GenAI ability, who wants to shape and sell solutions while staying technically credible. Key Responsibilities Own presales for the QE practice: qualify opportunities, run discovery calls, and scope QE solutions covering test strategy, test automation, performance, and security testing. Build effort estimates, proposals, solution decks, and responses to RFP and RFI documents, and defend the assumptions with customer stakeholders. Prepare and run tailored demos and proofs of concept, including AI assisted testing demos. Position and sell OSI accelerators into QE opportunities, showing where each reduces testing effort, cost, or risk. Identify, design, and drive net-new QE accelerators: reusable automation frameworks, AI assisted testing assets, and repeatable solution packages the practice can sell more than once. Own the go-to-market for QE accelerators: the pitch narrative, the demo, the reference architecture, and the packaging story. Design and demonstrate Gen AI assisted testing workflows: test case generation from requirements, test data synthesis, and automated test script drafting. Evaluate and honestly position AI features in testing tools, for example self-healing locators, visual validation, and risk-based test selection. Prototype LLM and retrieval-based aids for QE, such as a knowledge assistant over test documentation or GenAI support for defect triage. Research the QE tooling and vendor landscape and each prospect before engagement, and separate real capability from vendor marketing. Bridge the sold solution and the delivery team and contribute hands-on to early delivery on strategic accounts, so the approach is proven in practice. Support architecture and code reviews for QE automation and drive AI, GenAI adoption across the QE team. Produce solution documentation, reusable assets, and enablement material. Required Skills And Experience Core Experience 5 to 9 years of overall QA and QE experience, with at least 5 years hands-on in test automation. 2 or more years of practical, hands-on use of LLMs or GenAI in real work, not just awareness. Prior presales, solution consulting, or strong customer facing delivery exposure. QE and Automation Skills Strong with automation frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, and RestAssured. API and UI automation, regression, and in-sprint testing. Test integration in CI/CD pipelines and Git-based workflows. Performance testing (JMeter, k6, or NeoLoad) is an advantage. Presales and Accelerator Skills Scoping and estimating technical engagements and defending the assumptions. Building proposals and presenting confidently to customer stakeholders. Track record of building reusable frameworks or assets that can be productized, not just one-off delivery. AI and GenAI Skills Practical use of LLMs in real work, with the ability to check and validate generated output. Prompt design and retrieval (RAG) at a working level. Python or scripting for AI prototypes. Cloud and Ecosystem Understand at least one cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP). Experience with Containerized test environments is an advantage. Nice to Have Experience taking an internal accelerator or product to market, including pricing or packaging. Exposure to enterprise ERP or regulated industry testing. Security testing. Experience with AI augmented testing tools and vector databases. We are not looking for someone who Is not willing to work from the office. Has never worked directly with customers or in a client facing role. Has only manual testing experience with no hands-on automation. Treats AI and GenAI as buzzwords, with no real hands-on usage. Wants a pure delivery seat with no presales, solutioning, or customer interaction.

title: Senior Lead QA Engineer (FX)
description: Overview: Looking for a QA leader who strives for a better-quality engineering mindset. As a Lead QA Automation Engineer at LSEG, within our FX vertical, you’ll play a pivotal role in setting the quality direction and elevating the reliability of advanced FX trading platforms and high-performance, latency-sensitive systems. You’ll lead the PriceStream QA team in Bangkok, owning the test strategy for the FX pricing and rate-streaming systems that power our multi-dealer platform, while staying hands-on in the automation. What Awaits You: Own and drive the test strategy and quality roadmap for the PriceStream platform. Own end-to-end testing delivery across all releases, partnering with the Technical Program Manager, development lead, DevOps, infrastructure, and business teams to drive testing through to sign-off. Create and maintain the core test artifacts: test strategy, test plans, and test closure reports. Participate in production deployments and post-release validation. Lead root cause analysis (RCA) of production issues and drive corrective and preventive actions. Architect, develop, and maintain robust automation frameworks using Java, Selenium, Playwright, Cucumber-JVM, SQL, and Maven. Define and lead the FIX (Financial Information eXchange) protocol test strategy across pricing, quote, and order workflows. Lead server-side, API, and integration testing for the PriceStream platform. Drive infrastructure and deployment testing, including infra validation on AWS (Viking) cloud environments. Lead and execute comprehensive QA processes, including functional, regression, API, and database testing. Lead performance testing (load, stress, fault tolerance) on latency-critical pricing and distribution paths. Mentor and grow QA engineers, providing technical leadership, code review, and thought leadership on automation best practice. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, architects, and developers in an Agile environment, influencing design for testability. Utilize Docker and Kubernetes for test environment setup and automation. Manage multiple projects simultaneously, demonstrating flexibility and adaptability. Champion and implement a shift left approach, embedding quality early in the development lifecycle. Your Winning Qualities: 8+ years of experience in QA automation, including team or technical leadership. Strong knowledge of QA processes and best practices, with a track record of defining them. Hands-on experience with Java, Selenium, Playwright, Cucumber-JVM, SQL, and Maven. Experience with API, GUI, and database testing. Proven experience owning testing delivery and stakeholder management across Technical Program Management, development, DevOps, infrastructure, and business teams. Experience authoring and maintaining test strategy, test plans, and test closure reports. Experience supporting production deployments and leading root cause analysis of production issues. Proficient with AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex), and able to champion them to enhance QA and automation productivity across the team. Deep hands-on experience testing the FIX (Financial Information eXchange) protocol. Strong server-side / backend and integration testing expertise. Experience leading infrastructure testing and working with AWS (Viking) cloud environments. Good understanding of Docker and Kubernetes. In-depth understanding of technical architecture, test strategy implementation, and maintaining test plans. Proven ability to architect automation frameworks from the ground up. Ability to build mocks and simulator components for automation, enabling robust and isolated test environments. Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and influence across teams. What Sets You Apart: Experience with FIX Protocol and Kafka messaging—help us streamline complex trading workflows. Background in FX trading or financial technology—bring your domain expertise to the table. Passion for exploring new tools, frameworks, and testing strategies. A knack for solving tricky performance bottlenecks or debugging distributed systems. Curiosity about financial markets and eagerness to learn beyond your comfort zone. What You’ll Gain: Work with LSEG: Be part of a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider, working in our FX vertical at the forefront of financial technology. Hands-On Experience with FX Trading Platforms: Gain in-depth exposure to the world of foreign exchange trading, working on platforms that handle high transaction volumes and require utmost reliability. Exposure to High-Performance, Latency-Intensive Systems: Develop your skills in testing and optimizing systems where speed and performance are critical, preparing you for the most demanding technical challenges in finance. Become a Techno-Functional Expert: This role offers a unique blend of technical and domain knowledge, enabling you to understand both the technology stack and the business logic behind financial products. You’ll become a valuable asset with expertise that bridges the gap between technology and finance. Professional Growth and Learning: Collaborate with industry experts, adopt best practices, and stay updated with the latest tools and technologies in automation, cloud, and financial systems. Ownership and Impact: Enjoy the autonomy to take initiative, drive improvements, and make a tangible impact on the quality and success of mission-critical financial applications. description: Company: Beghou Website: Visit Website Business Type: Consulting Firm Company Type: Product & Service Business Model: B2B Funding Stage: Bootstrapped Industry: Life Science Salary Range: ₹ 30-35 Lacs PA Job Description Beghou brings over three decades of experience helping life sciences companies optimize their commercialization through strategic insight, advanced analytics, and technology. Our mission is to bring together analytical minds and innovative technology to help life sciences companies navigate the complexity of health care and improve patient outcomes. The QA Manager will play a pivotal leadership role in driving the overall quality strategy, execution, and culture within the organization. This role goes beyond traditional QA ownership—it's a strategic position responsible for shaping scalable testing frameworks, strengthening automation maturity, and ensuring the delivery of high‑quality, enterprise‑grade cloud products. As the QA Manager, you will lead and mentor a diverse team of QA engineers, elevate quality standards across the organization, and champion best‑in‑class testing practices. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders—product managers, engineering teams, DevOps, and release management—to embed quality at every stage of the product lifecycle. Provide career mentorship, performance guidance, and development opportunities to team members. Create awareness of QA offerings across the organisation and act as a strong representative of QA in cross-functional discussions. Process Ownership & Execution Drive end-to-end ownership of QA processes and deliverables — from requirement gathering through release validation. Ensure compliance with GRC processes and provide support to internal and external audits, as needed. Conduct root cause analysis on production issues and implement corrective/preventive actions to avoid recurrence. Utilise data-driven insights to continuously optimise testing strategies and processes. Cross-functional Collaboration Collaborate with product managers, software engineers, and operations teams throughout the software development lifecycle to embed quality from ideation to deployment. Participate actively in requirement gathering sessions, translating business needs into clear and testable acceptance criteria. Partner with release management teams to ensure thorough testing and validation of cloud-based releases. You'll Need To Have Bachelor’s/master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field. 15–20 years of QA experience with at least 5 years in a leadership role(mandatory) Strong hands-on experience with Selenium, performance testing tools, and automation frameworks. Deep understanding of agile software development, DevOps tools, and ticket tracking systems (e.g., JIRA, Azure DevOps). Proven experience in managing QA for cloud platforms and enterprise-scale applications. Having experience in process implementation. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and interpersonal skills. Preferred Qualifications Background in life sciences or healthcare software is a plus. Familiarity with Beghou platforms: Mainsail™, Meridian™, ARMADA™. Certifications: ISTQB, Certified Scrum Master (CSM), or equivalent.
